problem: How many positive integers $n \leq 20000$ have the properties that $2n$ has 64 positive divisors including 1 and $2n$, and $5n$ has 60 positive divisors including 1 and $5n$?

$$ n = 2^a \cdot 5^b \cdot k $$

The number of divisors function, denoted by $d(x)$, is multiplicative. For $x = q_1^{f_1} \cdots q_r^{f_r}$, $d(x) = (f_1+1)\cdots(f_r+1)$.

$$ 2n = 2^{a+1} \cdot 5^b \cdot k $$

$$ (a+2)(b+1)D = 64 \quad \text{--- (1)} $$
